name: Failed Field Leaves Other Cascades Intact
description: A failed mutation field MUST NOT affect the cascades of the others: its own cascade reports no entity changes, and the fields that succeeded describe their changes in full

input.mutation: mutation BatchUpdate { user1: updateUser(id: "1", name: "New Name") { success data { id name } cascade { updated { typename id operation entity } deleted { typename id } typeInvalidations { typename } metadata { affectedCount } } } user2: updateUser(id: "999", name: "Fail") { success errors { message code } cascade { updated { typename id operation entity } deleted { typename id } typeInvalidations { typename } metadata { affectedCount } } } }
